name: Goku
summary: Akira Toriyama's monkey-tailed martial artist: a Saiyan sent to Earth as a baby who grows into its mightiest defender. Debuted in Weekly Shōnen Jump in December 1984.
origin: Goku was born Kakarot on Planet Vegeta, home of the warrior Saiyan race, and was sent to Earth as a baby just before Frieza destroyed his homeworld. The old martial artist Son Gohan found him and raised him as a grandson. The baby was wild and aggressive until an accidental head injury left him cheerful and carefree. As a tailed boy with superhuman strength, he meets Bulma and sets out to find the seven wish-granting Dragon Balls, which starts a lifetime of training and ever-stronger opponents. Toriyama based him on Sun Wukong, the Monkey King of Journey to the West, mixed with the kung fu films of Jackie Chan and Bruce Lee.
powers: Ki energy attacks, including the Kamehameha and Spirit Bomb
Master of several martial arts styles

storyline.title: The boy with a tail
storyline.beat: Goku meets Bulma and joins her hunt for the Dragon Balls.

storyline.title: World Martial Arts
storyline.beat: After finishing runner-up twice, he wins the 23rd tournament by beating Piccolo, then marries Chi-Chi to keep a childhood promise.

storyline.title: A brother from space
storyline.beat: His older brother Raditz arrives and reveals Goku's alien heritage.

storyline.title: Super Saiyan
storyline.beat: When Frieza kills Krillin, Goku's fury turns him into a Super Saiyan for the first time.

storyline.title: Gods and Ultra Instinct
storyline.beat: Dragon Ball Super brings back Frieza, introduces gods of destruction and gives Goku the Ultra Instinct form.

storyline.title: Dragon Ball Daima
storyline.beat: Goku returns, shrunk back to childhood, in the anime series Dragon Ball Daima.

gossip.text: Super Saiyan hair is blond partly to save work: leaving it uncoloured meant no more inking Goku's black hair on every page.
Toriyama couldn't come up with a name for Goku's signature attack, so he asked his wife. She suggested Kamehameha.
Goku fights mainly to protect the innocent.
gossip.truth: Toriyama said Goku is more selfish than heroic and mostly wants strong opponents. He disliked the anime making him more noble.

gossip.text: Masako Nozawa has voiced Goku in Japanese in every Dragon Ball anime.
Goku was the first manga character to get a balloon in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, in 2018.
Toriyama said a young Jackie Chan would have been the only possible live-action Goku.
Japan's Anniversary Association officially declared 9 May 'Goku Day'.

quiz.q: What is Goku's Saiyan birth name?
quiz.why: He was born Kakarot on Planet Vegeta.

quiz.q: Who came up with the name Kamehameha?

quiz.why: He is based on Sun Wukong from Journey to the West.

theme.tagline: Eats for ten, fights for a hundred, naps like a cat.

timeline.title: Dragon Ball begins
timeline.note: Chapter 1 hits Weekly Shōnen Jump in December 1984, starring a tailed boy on a Dragon Ball hunt.

timeline.title: The first anime
timeline.note: Toei's Dragon Ball series premieres on Fuji TV in February 1986, with Masako Nozawa as Goku.

timeline.title: Dragon Ball Z
timeline.note: The Z anime premieres in April 1989 as grown-up Goku learns he is an alien Saiyan.

timeline.title: First Super Saiyan
timeline.note: On Namek, Frieza's cruelty pushes Goku into the golden form, in the manga and then the anime.

timeline.title: The manga ends
timeline.note: Toriyama wraps up Dragon Ball in June 1995 after more than ten years of weekly chapters.

timeline.title: Dragon Ball Super
timeline.note: A new anime begins in July 2015, bringing gods, multiverses and fresh forms for Goku.

timeline.title: Macy’s balloon
timeline.note: Goku becomes the first manga character to float in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

timeline.title: Dragon Ball Daima
timeline.note: An all-new anime from October 2024 turns Goku back into a kid for a Demon Realm adventure.
